title: Backstays

inlines.v: BACK'STAYS, noun [back and stay.] Long ropes or stays extending from the top-mast heads to both sides of a ship, to assist the shrouds in supporting the mast, when strained by a weight of sail, and prevent it from giving way and falling overboard.
